name: Fair Isaac
summary: Fair Isaac is named in 1 Part of The Buildout, most recently Part 9: Habit Was the Moat. Agents Are Draining It..

parts.headline: Habit Was the Moat. Agents Are Draining It.

mentions.excerpt: The 1,600% price increase FICO pushed through in five years, followed by a lost monopoly and a 26% one-day fall, is a reminder that a software seat can be priced away faster than it can be defended.
